brief: The 5-product skincare routine that replaced my 14-step regimen.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: A SKIN MINIMALIST APPROACH TO RADIANCE

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: THE RESET
slots.body: I spent years layering fourteen products until my barrier cried for mercy. Now I rely on five intentional formulas that deliver clinical results without the overwhelm. Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: MELTING BALM
slots.body: Begin with an oil cleanser to dissolve sunscreen and sebum without stripping natural lipids. This single step replaces both makeup remover and foaming wash. Massage onto dry skin, then emulsify with warm water.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: HYDRATING ESSENCE
slots.body: A lightweight toner preps the skin and amplifies every layer that follows. Think of it as the primer that bridges cleansing and treatment. Press gently into damp skin for maximum absorption.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: VITAMIN C SERUM
slots.body: One active serum each morning is all you need for brightness and environmental defense. This antioxidant step replaces multiple boosters and spot correctors. Apply three drops to face and neck.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: BARRIER CREAM
slots.body: A ceramide-rich moisturizer seals in hydration and supports the skin's natural defense system. It eliminates the need for separate face oils and overnight masks. Smooth upward until fully absorbed.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: MINERAL SHIELD
slots.body: Daily SPF is non-negotiable and the final layer of your morning ritual. A broad-spectrum mineral formula protects against premature aging and post-inflammatory marks. Reapply every two hours in direct sun.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: SIMPLIFY YOUR ROUTINE
slots.body: Discover the five-product routine tailored to your skin type and concerns.
